testimonials.name: JOSE FRANCH
testimonials.quote: Collaborating with Vicent Egea Insa on the creation of new works was an unforgettable experience. Vicent got me to embark on a journey of sounds and emotions I had never experienced before. All of it thanks to his prodigious creativity and great technical command.

testimonials.name: BEN KOPEC
testimonials.quote: Vicent is a talented composer across multiple genres. I'm always pleased with the quality of work from him. His compositions are fresh, compelling, and well balanced.

testimonials.name: HENK UMMELS
testimonials.quote: Since 2015, Maestro Vicent Egea Insa has been a respected and valuable composer. Masterpieces such as his solo and wind band pieces are of excellent quality. Besides being a skilled composer, Vicent is a very pleasant person to work with. Communicatively very sociable and flexible.

testimonials.name: ANDRÉS VALERO CASTELLS
testimonials.quote: Maestro Vicent Egea possesses great conducting talent, based on rigorous work stemming from an exhaustive knowledge of the score and from respect for, interest in and love of what he conducts. Moreover, he does so with the utmost energy that he instils in his concerts, becoming the interpreter composers wish for.

testimonials.name: BERNARDO ADAM FERRERO
testimonials.quote: Vicent Egea is without doubt the kind of conductor to whom I would entrust any of my works with every guarantee of success. Beyond his human qualities, he is professionally very well trained; that, together with his experience, makes him a safe bet for any symphony ensemble.

about.title: Biography

short: Born in Madrid in 1985, he studied composition at the Real Conservatorio Superior de Música de Madrid and furthered his training at the Hochschule für Musik in Berlin. His catalogue spans orchestral, chamber, vocal and electroacoustic music, with a special focus on timbral exploration and the integration of new technologies.

He has received commissions from institutions such as the Orquesta Nacional de España, the Centro Nacional de Difusión Musical (CNDM), the Alicante Festival of Contemporary Music and the Ensemble Intercontemporain. His works have been premiered in venues such as the Auditorio Nacional, the Teatro Real, the Berlin Philharmonie and IRCAM in Paris.
long: His training includes studies with José Luis de Delás, Luis de Pablo and Helmut Lachenmann. He was awarded the National Composition Prize in 2018 and the BBVA Foundation Frontiers of Knowledge Award in 2021. He has been composer in residence at the Academia de España in Rome (2016-2017) and at the Cité Internationale des Arts in Paris (2019).

His music is characterized by rigorous writing that seeks to expand the expressive possibilities of traditional instruments, combining extended techniques with a melodic sensibility inherited from the European tradition. In recent years he has explored the intersection between acoustic instrument and real-time electronics, collaborating with research centres such as IRCAM and ZKM.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Vicent Egea Insa, as the owner of this website, is the controller of the personal data collected through this site.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of processing
paragraphs: Personal data will be processed for the following purposes:
Handling queries and requests for information.

sections.title: 3. Lawfulness
paragraphs: The legal basis for processing your data is your express consent when filling in the forms and ticking the box accepting this policy.

sections.title: 4. Recipients
paragraphs: Data will not be disclosed to third parties except under legal obligation.

sections.title: 5. Rights
paragraphs: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection by writing to the email address indicated in the contact section.

sections.title: 6. Retention
paragraphs: Data will be retained for as long as the relationship is maintained and erasure is not requested, and for the period necessary to comply with legal obligations.

sections.title: 7. Security measures
paragraphs: The necessary technical and organisational measures have been implemented to guarantee the security of personal data.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your actions and preferences over a period of time.

sections.title: 2. Types of cookies we use
paragraphs: Technical cookies (necessary): Essential for the website to function. They enable navigation and the use of the different options or services available on it.

Analytics cookies: Allow the number of users to be quantified and statistical measurement and analysis of users' use of the offered service to be carried out. We use Google Analytics for this purpose.

Preference cookies: Allow information to be remembered so that the user accesses the service with certain features that can differentiate their experience from that of other users (language, region, etc.).

sections.title: 3. Third-party cookies
paragraphs: This website may use third-party services which, on behalf of Google, will collect information for statistical purposes, regarding the user's use of the site and for the provision of other services related to the activity of the website and other Internet services.

sections.title: 4. Managing cookies
paragraphs: You may allow, block or delete the cookies installed on your computer through the settings of the browser installed on your device.
If you block cookies, some services or functionalities of the website may not be available.

sections.title: 5. Consent
paragraphs: By browsing and continuing on our website, you consent to the use of cookies under the conditions contained in this Cookie Policy.

sections.title: 6. Updates
paragraphs: We may update the Cookie Policy of our website; we therefore recommend reviewing this policy each time you access our website in order to be properly informed about how and why we use cookies.
